faq_q1: How do I place an order?
faq_a1: You can add products to your cart and checkout via WhatsApp. Click the "Checkout on WhatsApp" button in your cart to send your order directly to us.
faq_a2: Each product is available in multiple sizes (typically 15g, 50g, 250g, 500g). Select your preferred size from the dropdown on each product card.
faq_q3: Do you ship outside Tamil Nadu?
faq_a3: Yes, we ship across India. Please contact us via WhatsApp or email to discuss shipping options and charges for your location.
faq_a4: Yes, all our masala powders are made with natural ingredients and contain no artificial preservatives or additives. We use traditional methods to ensure freshness and quality.
